mid与最右边的数比较。mid小于最右边的数则最小值在mid左边，或最小值为mi.en: Compare mid with the rightmost number. If mid is less than the rightmost number, the minimum value is to the left of mid, or mid itself is the minimum. 找第k个数的思路：两个数组各取k/2，第k/2个数中较小的及其之前的都可以排除，.zh: 找第k个数的思路：两个数组各取k/2，第k/2个数中较小的及其之前的都可以排除，指针后移。然后k更新为k/2（即找未排除的数中的第k_new个），继续两边对比，移动指针，直到边界情况：一个数组清空或k=1为止。
找第k个数的思路：两个数组各取k/2，第k/2个数中较小的及其之前的都可以排除，.en: The idea for finding the k-th number: take k/2 from each of the two arrays, the smaller of the k/2-th numbers and all numbers before it can be eliminated, move the pointer forward. Then update k to k/2 (i.e., find the k_new-th number among the remaining numbers), continue comparing both sides, moving the pointers, until the boundary case: one array is empty or k=1.

上学期没敢写的一道题目，终于写掉了。 双堆+懒删除，懒删除的关键在于清除堆顶已删.en: A problem I didn't dare to write last semester, finally solved. Double heap + lazy deletion. The key to lazy deletion is clearing deleted elements at the heap top and balancing the double heap. Balancing is based on the actual size of the two heaps, not the heap's size, so extra variables are needed. First clear, balance, then clear; since it's based on the actual size, the two heaps will be balanced. 1. 栈。栈底放置上一个未匹配的右括号的编号。如果是左括号则下标进栈。如果是右括号弹出.zh: 栈。栈底放置上一个未匹配的右括号的编号。如果是左括号则下标进栈。如果是右括号弹出栈顶，能匹配则当前下标减去当前栈顶为一段合法长度。如果匹配不了则当前右括号进栈。 亦可dp，根据前一个括号的情况递推。 亦可从前往后从后往前各扫一遍。
栈。栈底放置上一个未匹配的右括号的编号。如果是左括号则下标进栈。如果是右括号弹出.en: Stack. The bottom of the stack holds the index of the last unmatched right parenthesis. If it's a left parenthesis, push its index onto the stack. If it's a right parenthesis, pop the top of the stack; if it matches, the current index minus the new top of the stack gives a valid segment length. If it doesn't match, push the current right parenthesis onto the stack. You can also use DP, recursing based on the previous parenthesis. You can also scan from front to back and back to front.

此时第k小的元素出现在nums[k]的位置，且前面的数都比它小，后面的数都比它大.zh: 此时第k小的元素出现在nums[k]的位置，且前面的数都比它小，后面的数都比它大。 亦可哈希表。 亦可随机化。随机选一个数并判断它是不是众数。 亦可分治，其中一段的众数必定为整体的众数，一直分治到长度为1，再返回。如果判断不出来就统计个数以得出正确众数。 亦可Boyer-Moore 算法。
此时第k小的元素出现在nums[k]的位置，且前面的数都比它小，后面的数都比它大.en: At this time, the k-th smallest element appears at the position nums[k], with all preceding numbers smaller than it and all subsequent numbers larger than it. A hash table can also be used. Randomization is also an option: randomly select a number and check if it is the majority. Divide and conquer is also feasible, where the majority of a segment must be the overall majority, continue dividing until the length is 1, then return. If it cannot be determined, count the occurrences to find the correct majority. The Boyer-Moore algorithm can also be used.

，从链表头部（0，入度为0）出发，找到快慢指针相遇的点。然后两个指针分别从头部和.zh: ，从链表头部（0，入度为0）出发，找到快慢指针相遇的点。然后两个指针分别从头部和相遇点跑，相遇的点为入圈口。由于入度=出现次数，因此入圈口的点即为出现超过一次的点。
，从链表头部（0，入度为0）出发，找到快慢指针相遇的点。然后两个指针分别从头部和.en: Starting from the head of the linked list (0, in-degree 0), find the point where the fast and slow pointers meet. Then let the two pointers run respectively from the head and the meeting point; the meeting point is the entrance of the cycle. Since in-degree = occurrence count, the entrance node of the cycle is the node that appears more than once.
